head:
The first eight prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.  
There are infinitely many primes because, assuming a finite list of all primes, multiplying them together and adding 1 produces a number not divisible by any prime in the list, implying either a new prime or a contradiction.
